```{R, echo = FALSE}

library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(lubridate)
```


# load data

```{R}

# Set up filepath ------------------------------------

FolderPath = paste0("C:/Users/cbousfield/OneDrive - Department for Education/Documents/9. Sep 2025/Hackathon/data/")

# Define the full path to CSV files
filePath_links <- paste0(FolderPath, "links_edubasealldata20250903.csv")
filePath_groups <- paste0(FolderPath, "groups.csv")
filePath_educase_all <- paste0(FolderPath, "edubasealldata20250903.csv")

# Read the CSV files
data_links <- read.csv(filePath_links, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
data_groups <- read.csv(filePath_groups, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
data_edubase_all <- read.csv(filePath_educase_all, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)


```

```{R}

links_full_data <- data_links %>%
  rename("other_URN" = URN) %>%
  left_join(data_edubase_all, by = c("LinkURN" = "URN"))

```

```{R}

check_name <- links_full_data %>%
  filter(LinkName != EstablishmentName)

# infant predecessor to primary - showing no previous junior/primary
Torriano_eg <- links_full_data %>%
  filter((str_starts(LinkName, "Torriano")))

# link established different to open and close dates
Abbey_hill_eg <- links_full_data %>%
  filter((str_starts(LinkName, "Abbey Hill Primary & Nursery")) 
         & (str_ends(LinkEstablishedDate, "2023")))

# fine
Trinity_eg <- links_full_data %>%
  filter((str_starts(LinkName, "Trinity Catholic College")))

summary_link_types <- links_full_data %>%
  group_by(LinkType) %>%
  summarise(count = n())


all_successors <- links_full_data %>%
  filter(str_starts(LinkType, "Successor"))

merged_successors <- all_successors %>%
  filter(LinkType == "Successor - merged")

amalgamated_successors <- all_successors %>%
  filter(LinkType == "Successor - amalgamated")


successor_date_diffs <- all_successors %>%
  mutate(
    LinkEstablishedDate <- gsub("-", "", LinkEstablishedDate),
    LinkEstablishedDate = dmy(LinkEstablishedDate), 
    OpenDate <- gsub("-", "", OpenDate),
    OpenDate = dmy(OpenDate),
    date_diff = abs(difftime(LinkEstablishedDate, OpenDate, units = "days"))
  ) %>%
  filter(date_diff > 1)

all_predeccessors <- links_full_data %>%
  filter(str_starts(LinkType, "Predecessor"))

predeccessor_date_diffs_30_plus <- all_predeccessors %>%
  mutate(
    LinkEstablishedDate <- gsub("-", "", LinkEstablishedDate),
    LinkEstablishedDate = dmy(LinkEstablishedDate), 
    CloseDate <- gsub("-", "", CloseDate),
    CloseDate = dmy(CloseDate),
    date_diff = abs(difftime(LinkEstablishedDate, CloseDate, units = "days"))
  ) %>%
  filter(date_diff > 29)

```
